title: Multi-Layer Probe Ensembling for Misalignment: Cheap Robustness Test

original_idea.body: Train single-layer deception probes and a multi-layer ensemble on an open model and compare in-distribution AUROC and transfer to a different deception scenario.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Testing whether multi-layer ensembling fixes brittle deception-probe transfer is directly actionable for activation monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Single-layer vs multi-layer probe ensemble plus transfer test; inherited methodology, single GPU.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused ID-AUROC plus transfer comparison; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, low-resource monitoring, lab-independent activation work.

novelty.reasoning: Multi-layer ensembling shown for capability probes; the misalignment-transfer extension may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Ensembling shown for capability probes; the deception-transfer case may be open.
